question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a sessions.list-backed builtin now, or should it wait for the broader sessions.activity Gateway contract before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The UI request is clear, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review, proof, security, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader per-session activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer stable API.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing only after this issue's unique status-widget requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its review, proof, security, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision spans Control UI plugin-tab product fit and dashboard acceptance, where steipete has the strongest current-main ownership signal.
